strict: All six dimensions true AND valid output; every scheduled cell remains in the denominator.

codes.Q: query-like keywords instead of an information objective
codes.X: execution failure or uncompleted scheduled cell

coherence: Count resolution objectives, not atomic facts, answer nouns or question marks.
A bounded event, source, product feature profile or a comparison such as same-university education can constitute one judgment with complementary facets.
Sharing a candidate name or contributing to the final answer alone is insufficient: donation plus marital history, or promotion plus education, are separable objectives.
Discovery may ask which entity fits a bounded description present in Q. This does not assert that a candidate already satisfies it.

A candidate in C/H may be tested. H does not license an event/identity/date as an established premise. Asking an attribute of an unverified relation fails P; asking about an unbound unnamed referent fails A when identity must first be resolved.
Independent lexical queries may be generated without other results; candidate-specific dependent queries must await evidence. Hypothetical query feasibility is not observed retrieval success.
review: Single Codex reviewer, QCH and returned Need only; no future trajectory, gold or full-document audit. Mask arms in first-pass packets. Prior E0 familiarity prevents a claim of perfect blinding. Record dimension reasons, premise anchors, objective decomposition and ambiguity offline, never in model payload.
failure_semantics: Failed/blocked/incomplete output is strict=false, code X, semantic dimensions null. No fictitious P/A/W judgment for absent output.

development_mechanism_reference.B1: P/A union count drops by at least 2 versus concurrent B0; W changes by at most 1 cell
development_mechanism_reference.B2: W count drops by at least 1 versus concurrent B0; P/A union changes by at most 1 cell
development_mechanism_reference.B3: P/A union drops by at least 2, W drops by at least 1; strict-valid improves by at least 2 cells
development_mechanism_reference.execution: All arms must return valid output for at least 90% of scheduled states
development_mechanism_reference.otherwise: Pause for mechanism analysis; at most one separately frozen bounded revision, no automatic fresh execution. Zero baseline errors are floor effects, not evidence of improvement.

fresh_gate_notes: P+A uses the conservative sum, double-counting a cell with both; also report the union. All gates conjunctive, no rounding before comparison. No-H reported separately. Freshness/support/provenance and the prespecified size checks are mandatory. These are engineering thresholds, not significance tests.
